dimensions.assessment: Affects state agencies, tribal fishery managers, eligible Indian Tribes in Washington, pinniped populations, and protected fish species.
dimensions.evidence: an eligible entity may apply to the Secretary for a permit... meaning the State of Washington and each covered Indian Tribe.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes intentional lethal taking of covered pinnipeds up to 10 percent of the annual potential biological removal level and creates a technology accelerator program.
dimensions.evidence: cumulative number of covered pinnipeds authorized to be taken each year under all permits... shall not exceed 10 percent

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a technology accelerator program subject to the availability of appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: Subject to the availability of appropriations, the Secretary... shall establish and maintain... a program

dimensions.assessment: Amends Section 120 of the Marine Mammal Protection Act of 1972 regarding adaptive pinniped management and permit issuances.
dimensions.evidence: Section 120 of the Marine Mammal Protection Act of 1972 (16 U.S.C. 1389) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permits are effective for up to 5 years with renewal options, and reporting mandates extend up to 10 years.
dimensions.evidence: A permit issued under paragraph (1) shall be effective for a period of not more than 5 years

missing_information: Specific funding amounts authorized for the Columbia River Pinniped Exclusion Technology Accelerator
Exact number of pinnipeds that will be lethally taken under the permits
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Marine Mammal Protection Act to authorize lethal removal permits for certain pinnipeds in Washington state waters and the Columbia River basin to protect endangered salmon, and establishes a technology accelerator program.
